items.source_en:
Reports of pirate activity continue to plague the Galaxy.

While the Mission Boards supply us with intel, the Collective often changes its targets to keep us guessing. According to Toft's report, there are three types of operations the Collective uses to fill its coffers.

1. Piracy
2. Smuggling
3. Theft 

They have honed these operations under their current leadership, and we would do well to study their tactics so that we can better protect the Galaxy.

items.source_en:
Mr. Corbin,

Your voyage has been booked and everyone here is excited for your keynote speech. As a reminder, our convention is apolitical. So we're asking all speakers to refrain from talking about any sensitive issues for either the Rebel Alliance or Galactic Empire. What our attendees are most interested in is how to post sales numbers like you, and what challenges you face and how you overcome them.

All expenses are paid and you have a 3000 credit a day per diem. Thursday night there is a dinner for all the speakers, if you would like to attend please RSVP now. It is formal and we'd be thrilled if you join us.

Thanks for doing this, and looking forward to meeting you in person!

-Glenda
items.legacy_ko:
코빈 씨,

여행 예약이 완료되었습니다. 모두가 당신의 기조연설을 기대하고 있습니다. 참고로, 우리 컨벤션은 정치적 중립을 지향합니다. 따라서 모든 연사는 반란군 연합이나 은하 제국과 관련된 민감한 사안에 대한 언급을 자제해 주시기 바랍니다. 참석자들은 당신처럼 높은 매출을 기록하는 비결, 그리고 당신이 겪는 도전과 극복 과정에 대해 가장 관심이 많습니다.

모든 경비는 지원되며 하루 3000 크레딧의 일당이 지급됩니다. 목요일 밤에는 연사들을 위한 만찬이 준비되어 있으니 참석을 원하시면 지금 회신해 주십시오. 격식 있는 자리라 참석해 주신다면 큰 영광이겠습니다.

협조해 주셔서 감사합니다. 직접 뵙기를 고대하겠습니다!

-글렌다

Freedom.

It is the right of every being, yet the first thing the Empire seeks to take. We remember a time when exploration was not a crime, when the stars were open to all who dared to reach for them. That time will come again.

The Empire calls us insurgents. Terrorists. But we ask—who built the chains first? Who took the voice of entire worlds and silenced them beneath the weight of a boot? Here, on Dantoo Town, we do not kneel. We do not submit.

Freedom is not given—it is won.

locations.vanilla_source_en:
Freedom.

Throughout the course of recorded history, that word has meant so many things to so many people. For Solomon Coe, true understanding of the concept came in the year 2161, when the newly-formed United Colonies issued the Centaurus Proclamation, thereby formalizing the colonization of any star system in our galaxy. That was the moment Solomon Coe knew that his destiny lay elsewhere. In order to free himself, both body and spirit, he would need to heed his wanderlust and venture alone into the stars. And so he did.

Sadly, the United Colonies commitment to the very freedom they projected was short lived. As Solomon Coe expanded upon his dream, and invited other star systems to join him in what he called the Freestar Collective, United Colonies leadership revealed their true colors. Exploration was seen as aggression. Freedom, as defiance.

What followed were two bloody conflicts - the Narion War and Colony War. In both, the United Colonies tried to erase Akila City, and indeed the entire Freestar Collective, from the face of the Settled Systems. They claimed they were defending their borders. Outer space is infinite, and yet they wanted our own. Why? Because the very thought of freedom, to those who wish only to control, is unacceptable.

And yet, here you stand. In Akila City, proud capital of the Freestar Collective. Freedom is hard earned. Freedom is hard fought. But freedom is always worth it.
